mission: Improve contact localization transfer using the enlarged Wave D contact gold; evaluate median/P75/P90 timing error, coverage, abstention, wrong-marker rate grouped by bundle/session; report confidence-conditioned error.

datasetScope.gold: datasets/paddle-bench/bundles/*/annotation/devin-visual-v3-waveD-contact.json (Wave D enlarged contact gold, 15 events / 10 target-owned across 8 bundles, 5 sessions)
datasetScope.ball: devin-visual-v2-waveC.json + devin-visual-v4-waveD2-ball.json gold ball frames (ORACLE-BALL condition)
datasetScope.heldOut: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 never read, labeled, or tuned against
datasetScope.grouping: bundle + source session (dvids-944403/faead/marne/sasebo/wgm); no random-frame splits

configuration.condition: LINUX-CPU replay; paddle track ABSENT (wrist-proxy gating path exercised); ball observations are visually-verified gold frames (conf 0.9) so this measures temporal fusion, NOT the ball tracker; NOT the Apple-Vision canonical cascade

change.what: contact-evidence-4.1 → 4.2: family-conditioned wrist-proxy gate. Extended strokes (drive/serve/overhead) contact the ball ~arm+paddle beyond the wrist (measured 1.70 torso on the gold drive), so the wrist gate (proxy used only when no paddle track exists) widens to full 1.8 / reject 2.6 torso and the away-contradiction limit to 2.2 torso for those families. Compact (volley/dink) and unknown families keep the dev-tuned radii unchanged, so every fabrication safeguard (target gating, motion support, flight-speed discount, contradiction veto, multimodal abstention) is untouched where it was tuned.
change.why: Baseline forensics on the enlarged gold: the 944403 drive event had a gold-verified ball direction change 9ms from gold contact that was crushed (mass 0.038) by the compact wrist gate (1.70 torso → ×0.11) even though it was the correct moment, leaving two wrist-peak modes and a multimodal abstention.

v4_2.delta: +1 target estimate (944403 drive: 18ms error, conf 0.78, ball-confirmed; previously multimodal abstention). All other rows byte-identical to baseline.

metrics.abstentions: 4/10 target events abstain (faead-feed x2, faead-rally x2): multimodal wrist evidence with heavily discounted ball kernels; forensic kernels confirm no single defensible moment, so abstention is honest, not a bug.

findings: Wrist-proxy gate radii tuned on compact dev strokes do not transfer to extended strokes: the ball at a drive contact sits ~1.7 torso from the wrist, past the 0.9 full-trust radius (fix shipped as v4.2, family-conditioned so compact safeguards are unchanged).

Ball flight-speed prior (full trust at >=6 torso/s) does not transfer to soft shots: gold-verified balls at real contacts on the enlarged gold measured 2.2-3.7 torso/s and are discounted x0.05-x0.42. NOT changed: the same 2-3 torso/s range is exactly the held-out rally1 dead-ball jitter this discount exists to kill, and rally1 cannot be replayed on Linux (no committed pose), so a change is unverifiable against its known failure mode. Recommend revisiting with a Mac replay.
Do-not-assume-wrist-peak-equals-contact confirmed again: 944403 drive gold contact (21113ms) falls in the valley between wrist peaks at 20938/21371ms; only the gated ball turn localizes it.
artifacts: datasets/experiments/wave-e/e02-contact-gold-replay-metrics.json (full per-row replay, per-bundle and per-session metrics; regenerated by pnpm --filter @pickle/vision-geometry eval)
packages/vision-geometry/eval/contactGold.eval.ts (metrics eval + regression floor: wrong-marker rate <=0.25, median <=70ms, high-confidence estimates never >132ms)
packages/vision-geometry/test/offlineStroke.test.ts (new unit test: extended-family gate widens, unknown stays tight)

Held-out verification of any flight-ramp change (rally1 has no committed pose artifacts for Linux replay).
